parameters.name: DtsInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or subscribe instance.

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: SynchronizationDirection
parameters.description:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:

- **Forward**: forward.
- **Reverse**: reverse.

> - Default value: **Forward**.
- You can set this parameter to **Reverse** to stop the reverse synchronization link only if the topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization.

parameters.name: ZeroEtlJob
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the node is a seamless integration (zero-ETL) node. Valid values:

- **false**: No.
- **true**: Yes.
